title: Dynamics of tumor ecosystems and microbiome in response to neoadjuvant ABFOLFOX treatment in patients with unresectable colorectal cancer with liver metastasis.
authors: Kim, Wonkyung; Kim, Jeong Eun; Hong, Yong Sang; Hwang, Dae Wook; Kim, Jihun; Lee, Ji Sung; Shin, Jin Ho; Kim, Tae Won; Nagarkar, Deepti; Byrd, Allyson; Sung, Chang Ohk; Kim, Sun Young
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦结直肠癌肝转移患者新辅助治疗中肿瘤生态系统与微生物组的动态变化，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合机制或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: This study aims to explore the effects of neoadjuvant atezolizumab, bevacizumab, leucovorin, 5-fluorouracil, and oxaliplatin (ABFOLFOX) in patients with unresectable colorectal liver metastases (CRLM), focusing on the molecular dynamics of tumor ecosystems (TE) of CRLM and their impact on treatment outcomes. METHODS: The study comprises two cohorts with CRLM tissue samples analyzed with RNA sequencing and immunohistochemical staining: cross-sectional cohort A (n = 60, CRLM treated with or without neoadjuvant chemotherapy) and prospectively registered cohort B (n = 20 with serial sampling and treated with ABFOLFOX). Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed for stool samples from cohort B. RESULTS: Durable disease control (PFS >/= 24 months) was observed in 35% (7/20) of patients receiving ABFOLFOX. Analysis revealed a progressive increase in the immunogenic microenvironment within CRLM tissues upon the addition of therapeutic agents, specifically bevacizumab, and the most significant TE changes in CRLM were observed in those treated with ABFOLFOX in cohort B. The monocyte lineage was significantly associated with benefit from ABFOLFOX. Good responders exhibited improved immune response and notable activation of the SP140 transcription factor regulon. Moreover, microbiome analysis revealed that high abundance of Prevotella was positively correlated with good response and enhanced immune environment within the tumor. Causal mediation analysis suggested that the gut microbiome partially links the ABFOLFOX treatment response to the tumor microenvironment. CONCLUSIONS: ABFOLFOX enhances the TE immune profile of CRLM, which is further augmented by the gut-liver axis characterized by Prevotella abundance, and can induce durable disease control in a subgroup of patients. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT03698461. May 08, 2019 (prospectively registered).
abstract_zh: 背景：本研究旨在探讨新辅助阿替利珠单抗、贝伐珠单抗、亚叶酸钙、5-氟尿嘧啶和奥沙利铂（ABFOLFOX）在不可切除结直肠癌肝转移（CRLM）患者中的作用，重点关注CRLM肿瘤生态系统（TE）的分子动力学及其对治疗结局的影响。方法：本研究包含两个队列，CRLM组织样本通过RNA测序和免疫组织化学染色进行分析：横断面队列A（n = 60，接受或不接受新辅助化疗的CRLM）和前瞻性注册队列B（n = 20，接受ABFOLFOX治疗并进行连续采样）。对队列B的粪便样本进行鸟枪法宏基因组测序。结果：在接受ABFOLFOX治疗的患者中，35%（7/20）观察到持久疾病控制（PFS ≥ 24个月）。分析显示，随着治疗药物（特别是贝伐珠单抗）的加入，CRLM组织内免疫原性微环境逐步增加，且在队列B中接受ABFOLFOX治疗的患者观察到最显著的TE变化。单核细胞谱系与ABFOLFOX获益显著相关。良好应答者表现出改善的免疫反应和SP140转录因子调节子的显著激活。此外，微生物组分析显示，高丰度的普雷沃菌属（Prevotella）与良好应答及肿瘤内增强的免疫环境呈正相关。因果中介分析提示，肠道微生物组部分介导了ABFOLFOX治疗反应与肿瘤微环境之间的关联。结论：ABFOLFOX增强CRLM的TE免疫谱，这一效应通过以普雷沃菌属丰度为特征的肠-肝轴进一步放大，并可在亚组患者中诱导持久疾病控制。试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov，NCT03698461。2019年5月8日（前瞻性注册）。
